purpose: Run-level expected profile schema for the fingerprint contract gate.

semantics.flatKeys: Contracts address values with dotted keys such as pixelscan.location.Country.
semantics.missingDynamicValue: A mapped dynamic field fails the official gate unless the contract policy is present-only.
semantics.presentPolicy: The actual DOM value must be non-empty; no literal expected value is required.
semantics.forbiddenSignals: Forbidden signals are validated from the site contract, not from expected-profile values.
